part.text:
All 20 test suites pass (100%).

The fix in `include/fmt/std.h`:
- Added a `type_` member to `formatter<std::filesystem::path, Char>` and parse `g`/`n` presentation types after align/width/`?` (include/fmt/std.h:118)
- In `format`, the string to format is now `p.generic_string<path_char>()` when `type_ == 'g'`, otherwise `p.native()` (include/fmt/std.h:140-143); this also flows into the escaped/debug and Char-conversion paths
- The `Char == path_char` branch now builds its view directly from `path_string` instead of re-calling `p.string<Char>()`, so `{:g}` renders generic separators (`C:/foo` on Windows) while `{}`/`{:n}` render the native form
